passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Alif-Lam-Mim; Allah no deity except Him the Living the Sustainer; tanzil of the Book in truth confirming what was before; Torah and Gospel revealed before as guidance; Furqan revealed; those who disbelieve in Allah's signs have severe punishment; Allah Aziz Dhu Intiqam; nothing hidden from Allah in earth or heaven; He forms in wombs as He wills; Aziz Hakeem; muhkamat and mutashabihat ayat; those with zaygh follow mutashabih seeking fitnah and ta'wil; only Allah knows ta'wil; rasikhun in knowledge say we believe all from our Lord; only ulu al-albab remember; supplication: do not let hearts deviate after guidance; grant mercy; You are Wahhab; You gather people for Day no doubt; Allah does not break promise

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُ
نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ
مِن قَبۡلُ هُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۡهُ ءَايَٰتٞ مُّحۡكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٞۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ زَيۡغٞ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنۡهُ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ ٱلۡفِتۡنَةِ وَٱبۡتِغَآءَ تَأۡوِيلِهِۦۖ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ تَأۡوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۗ وَٱلرَّـٰسِخُونَ فِي ٱلۡعِلۡمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلّٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ رَبِّنَاۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

mainSubject.label: Opening declaration of divine unity (tawheed): Allah as Hayy Qayyum; Quranic revelation as truth confirming prior scriptures (Torah, Gospel); Furqan as criterion; warning of severe punishment for disbelievers; divine omniscience (nothing hidden); embryonic formation as sign of creative power; muhkamat (precise) and mutashabihat (ambiguous) verses distinguished; deviation of hearts pursuing ambiguous texts seeking discord; exclusive divine knowledge of interpretation; firm-grounded scholars affirm belief in entirety; supplication against heart-deviation post-guidance; affirmation of gathering on Judgment Day without doubt; divine faithfulness to promise

notes: Pass A Imran passage 1/4. Establishes foundational tawheed, scripture theology, and hermeneutical principles. Muhkamat/mutashabihat distinction is central to Quranic sciences. Supplication in 3:8 is taught supplication model. Links to tawheed-fundamentals, divine-scriptures, quran-science.
